name: Block Bindings source
description: Adds a Block Bindings source (core since WP 6.5) so editors can point block attributes at project data instead of typed values. Generates a Registrable that registers the source through 'register_block_bindings_source' on init with a get_value callback carrying core's exact signature, declares the block context it needs, and no-ops on WP < 6.5.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the source class. Default 'Inc\Services' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the source file. Default 'includes/Services'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Services'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Services'.
Logical source name, e.g. 'product-price'. Normalised to a PascalCase class name and a kebab-case source slug.
PascalCase class name, derived from name.
Slug half of the registered source name, derived from name. Core allows only lowercase alphanumerics and dashes here.
Namespace half of the registered source name, e.g. 'rtcamp' produces 'rtcamp/product-price'. Core requires the prefix.
Human-readable source label shown in the editor's bindings UI.
Text domain for the label string. The engine cannot read a plugin header, so pass it explicitly when it is not 'my-plugin'.

wiring.description: Add the class to a Services module so the framework Loader instantiates it and calls register_hooks(). If no suitable module exists, scaffold one first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Services --kind=registrable`.
